scope: SQL paths only; excludes HTTP, crypto and audit-broker delivery
postgres_version: PostgreSQL 18.2 on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by clang version 21.1.8, 64-bit
voter_distribution: distinct returning voters spread over the seeded population; two prior ballots each

postgres_statements.query:
SELECT * FROM sequent_backend.scheduled_event
            WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND election_event_id = $2 AND archived_at IS NULL

(
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM "sequent_backend"."cast_vote" cv
    WHERE cv.election_id = NEW.election_id
    AND cv.voter_id_string = NEW.voter_id_string
    AND cv.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
    AND cv.election_event_id = NEW.election_event_id
    AND cv.status IN ('valid', 'in-progress')
  ) >= allowed_revotes

SELECT id, num_allowed_revotes FROM sequent_backend.election
            WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND election_event_id = $2 AND id = $3

SELECT * 
    FROM sequent_backend.cast_vote
    WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND election_event_id = $2 AND election_id = $3
      AND voter_id_string = $4 AND status IN ($5 /*, ... */)
BEGIN

SELECT num_allowed_revotes                        FROM "sequent_backend"."election"
  WHERE id = NEW.election_id
  AND tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
  AND election_event_id = NEW.election_event_id
SELECT username FROM user_entity WHERE id = $1
BEGIN

INSERT INTO sequent_backend.cast_vote
        (tenant_id, election_event_id, election_id, voter_id_string, area_id,
         status, content, ballot_id, cast_ballot_signature)
    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $9, $8)
 RETURNING *
SELECT * FROM sequent_backend.area WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2

SELECT * FROM sequent_backend.election
            WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND election_event_id = $2 AND id = $3
SELECT * FROM sequent_backend.election_event WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2

SELECT value FROM sequent_backend.secret
    WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND election_event_id = $2 AND key = $3

SELECT election.presentation, election.status, election.voting_channels,
       period.start_date, period.end_date
FROM sequent_backend.election AS election
LEFT JOIN sequent_backend.election_voting_window AS period
    ON period.tenant_id = election.tenant_id
   AND period.election_event_id = election.election_event_id
   AND period.election_id = election.id
WHERE election.tenant_id = $1
  AND election.election_event_id = $2
  AND election.id = $3

SELECT count(*), coalesce(bool_or(
      cv.area_id IS NOT NULL AND cv.area_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.area_id
  ), false)
                                               FROM sequent_backend.cast_vote cv
  WHERE cv.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
    AND cv.election_event_id = NEW.election_event_id
    AND cv.election_id = NEW.election_id
    AND cv.voter_id_string = NEW.voter_id_string
    AND cv.status IN ('valid', 'in-progress')

INSERT INTO sequent_backend.cast_vote
        (tenant_id, election_event_id, election_id, voter_id_string, area_id,
         status, content, ballot_id, cast_ballot_signature)
    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $9, $8)
 RETURNING id, ballot_id, election_id, election_event_id, tenant_id, area_id, created_at, last_updated_at, cast_ballot_signature, voter_id_string, status
BEGIN
SELECT * FROM sequent_backend.area WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2
SELECT * FROM sequent_backend.election_event WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2

SELECT num_allowed_revotes                        FROM "sequent_backend"."election"
  WHERE id = NEW.election_id
  AND tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
  AND election_event_id = NEW.election_event_id

SELECT value FROM sequent_backend.secret
    WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND election_event_id = $2 AND key = $3

SELECT * FROM sequent_backend.scheduled_event
            WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND election_event_id = $2 AND archived_at IS NULL

(
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM "sequent_backend"."cast_vote" cv
    WHERE cv.election_id = NEW.election_id
    AND cv.voter_id_string = NEW.voter_id_string

    WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND election_event_id = $2 AND election_id = $3
      AND voter_id_string = $4 AND status IN ($5 /*, ... */)
